jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - AI Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Job Description

Forward-Deployed Engineer

Location:
Bellevue, WA

Remote

Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence

Company:
Aircall

Team:
Forward Deployed Engineering

About The Role

As a Forward-Deployed Engineer, you'll own the end-to-end delivery of technically sound, low-code AI solutions for Aircall customers. You'll design, implement, and operationalize workflows that connect the AI Agent with CRMs, help desks, and communication tools. You'll also play a key role in driving team upskilling, building reusable frameworks, and leading cross-functional initiatives that improve how Aircall deploys AI at scale. This is a hands-on role where you'll translate customer challenges into scalable technical solutions, working directly with Product and Engineering to refine Aircall's platform and accelerate adoption.

Customer Services

Discover more

jobs

job

software

Please note, this is not a software engineering role. This is a hybrid, revenue driving role across Solutions Engineering, Software Engineering, Consulting, Professional Services, and Product Ownership.

Engineering & Technology

What you'll do

Lead customer discovery and design sessions to map business processes, identify automation opportunities, and define solution architecture.
Design, build, and deploy integrations using low/no-code platforms (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato) and CRM automation tools (HubSpot Workflows, Salesforce Flow) with API connectors.
Collaborate with Engineering to validate technical feasibility, resolve blockers, and share field learnings that inform product improvements.
Configure and optimize the AI Agent — defining intents, prompts, actions, guardrails, and performance metrics.
Manage complex, cross-functional deployments — defining timelines, aligning stakeholders, ensuring accountability, and delivering on time and within scope.
Create scalable models and reusable frameworks (templates, playbooks, reference architectures) that make future projects faster and more consistent.
Champion continuous learning and enablement — train peers, run internal workshops, and document best practices to raise the technical bar across the team.
Run global, targeted outbound campaigns within the existing customer base to generate pipeline and accelerate adoption, working closely with the customer marketing team.
Collaborate with GTM leadership to embed routines and cadences that drive accountability for new product pipeline, forecast accuracy, and performance tracking.
Own regional top-line targets for assigned products (e.g., AI Voice Agent MRR generated per area) by collaborating with AEs and AMs who hold add-on quotas.
Act as an internal product owner within the GTM function—defining product-specific MRR strategies, coordinating cross-functional support, and ensuring Aircall delivers the leading AI-enabled communication platform.
Collaborate with Product and PMM to shape the AI Voice Agent roadmap based on customer needs, integration insights, and field learnings.
Drive internal and external product education, including enablement for System Integrators (SIs) and channel partners.
Maintain deep awareness of AI and CX industry trends, ensuring Aircall's positioning remains competitive and insights continuously feed back into product and GTM strategies.

What you'll bring

2–8 years or more in technical consulting, solutions engineering, or integration-focused project management.
Strong command of APIs, webhooks, and data structures (JSON, REST, GraphQL) — able to design and troubleshoot integrations confidently. Even better if you have experience with MCP Servers.
Hands-on experience with low-code orchestration tools (Zapier, Make, n8n, Workato) and CRM automation (HubSpot, Salesforce).
Practical understanding of AI workflow configuration, including prompt engineering, evaluation, and monitoring.
Proven ability to lead cross-functional projects, working with Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver scalable outcomes.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, translating between technical and business audiences.
A growth mindset — constantly learning new tools, frameworks, and ways to improve the customer experience and team capability.

Nice-to-haves

Experience in telephony, voice, or contact center systems (SIP/WebRTC, call routing, containment, AHT).
Familiarity with BI and analytics tools (Looker, BigQuery, Snowflake).
Exposure to scripting (JavaScript/Python) for light customization and debugging.

What Success Looks Like

Consistent delivery of high-quality, scalable AI Agent deployments with clear business outcomes.
Shortened time-to-first-value and increased automation adoption across SMB customers.
Reusable frameworks, models, and templates actively used by peers and partners.
Strong collaboration with Engineering and Product to enhance platform capabilities.
Demonstrated leadership in team enablement and upskilling, with measurable impact on technical excellence.
Sustained improvements in customer metrics (containment, AHT, CSAT) and revenue impact (ARR, NRR) driven by your solutions.

Salary & Benefits

Base salary range:
$90,000 – $136,000 per year.

Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence

Quarterly bonus:
20% of base salary.

Maximum OTE:
$170,000 (including $34,000 bonus).

The actual salary offered will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including skills, location, qualifications, and experience.

Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
Work-life balance is important at Aircall
Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
Competitive salary package & benefits

Why This Role is Unique

This is a role for builders, connectors, and enablers. You'll be at the intersection of AI innovation, customer experience, and scalable delivery — combining technical curiosity with a consulting mindset. Every project you lead not only delivers value for customers but also strengthens Aircall's internal capability to deploy AI faster and smarter.

Customer Relationship Management (CRM)

If you're motivated by making cutting-edge technology accessible and impactful — while continuously learning and helping others do the same — this is the perfect next step in your career.

jobs.title: Senior Research/Data Analyst (4206050)
jobs.description:
Job Location:
This position will be located at 930 Wildwood Dr., Jefferson City, MO 65109.

Why You’ll Love This Position

The Bureau of Data Modernization and Interoperability is modernizing Missouri’s public health data systems, and we’re looking for a motivated professional to help lead this work. With a strong focus on immunization data, you’ll streamline statewide health data reporting, guide a team that onboards new data sharing partners, and serve as our HL7 onboarding expert. This role also includes project management responsibilities, ensuring key modernization initiatives move forward on time and in coordination with internal and external partners. Your work with immunization data will directly enable faster public health response, strengthen outbreak prevention, and improve insights into vaccine coverage.

The salary indicated represents a base pay rate. If the individual selected or the position is eligible for a pay differential (e.g., shift, security, or years of service), it will be added to the total compensation in your paycheck. A pay differential does not raise your base pay.

Lead and manage immunization provider onboarding operations and data modernization projects across the full project lifecycle, ensuring compliance with policies and standards.
Oversee onboarding of new reporters, including HL7 message review, validation, troubleshooting, and configuration of system connectivity for production reporting.
Serve as the technical escalation point for complex interoperability, data quality, and HL7 structure/content issues while supporting and mentoring the onboarding team.
Monitor system performance, data quality, provider connections, and operational workflows, implementing process improvements, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and ongoing team training.
Develop SQL queries and data tools to support validation, reporting, and provider feedback, while collaborating with internal teams, vendors, and intermediaries on system enhancements.
Support data governance, security best practices (including NIST frameworks), and cross-cutting informatics activities to ensure accurate reporting, compliance, and high-quality immunization data.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree and 4-6 years of relevant experience and/or appropriate certification.
Basic knowledge of statistical software (R, SPSS, SAS, SQL etc.), and ability to effectively use data querying tools.
Basic understanding of health data standards, including HL7 messaging, LOINC laboratory and clinical codes, and SNOMED medical terminology used in electronic health systems and data exchange (preferred, but not required).
Project management experience or the willingness to learn is highly desirable.
Highly organized and detail oriented with excellent communication skills (both written and verbal)

Lack of post‐secondary education will not be used as the sole basis denying consideration to any applicant.

The State of Missouri offers an excellent benefits package that includes a defined pension plan, generous amounts of leave and holiday time, and eligibility for health insurance coverage. Your total compensation is more than the dollars you receive in your paycheck. To help demonstrate the value of working for the State of Missouri, we have created an interactive Total Compensation Calculator. This tool provides a comprehensive view of benefits and more that are offered to prospective employees. The Total Compensation Calculator and other applicant resources can be found here.

Sarah Finley, sarah.finley@health.mo.gov

jobs.title: Senior Geologist – Major NATM Tunnel Project | New York, USA
jobs.description:
My client is seeking an experienced Senior Geologist
to join a major tunnel infrastructure project in New York
. This is an excellent opportunity to play a leading technical role on a challenging NATM (New Austrian Tunnelling Method)
project, acting as the Designer's Representative
and providing expert guidance throughout the construction phase.

Key Responsibilities

Provide technical leadership and coordinate the on-site team, including geologists, tunnel inspectors, and site supervisors.
Oversee the implementation and compliance of excavation and ground support works in accordance with the Required Excavation and Support (RES) specifications.
Ensure all construction activities are executed in line with the approved design, project specifications, and relevant quality and safety standards.
Assess and interpret geological and hydrogeological conditions throughout tunnel excavation.
Prepare and review daily, weekly, monthly, and final project reports.
Work closely with the construction management team, designers, and key project stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
Monitor construction progress and provide technical recommendations to optimize excavation methods, sequencing, and overall project performance.

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geology, Civil Engineering, Engineering Geology, or a related discipline.
Minimum of 15 years' experience on NATM tunnel construction projects.
Previous experience working on large-scale international tunnelling projects.
Strong understanding of NATM construction methods, excavation techniques, ground support systems, and tunnelling equipment.
Extensive experience assessing geological and hydrogeological conditions in underground construction.
Demonstrated ability to lead and manage multidisciplinary site teams.
A proactive, solutions-focused approach with excellent organizational and communication skills.
Valid authorization to work in the USA

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description

Keep projects moving. Keep clients happy. Build a career you'll be proud of.

At Singleton Construction, we know that great projects don't happen by chance - they happen because great people keep everything moving.

As a Project Coordinator, you'll be at the heart of our project teams, helping deliver nationwide retail and commercial construction programmes for some of America's most recognised brands. You'll work alongside experienced Project Managers and Superintendents, ensuring every detail is organised, every deadline is met and every client receives the exceptional service we're known for.

If you're someone who thrives on organisation, enjoys solving problems and loves seeing a project come together, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Singleton?

We're not the biggest construction company, and we're proud of that.

Our size means you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact, build meaningful relationships and develop your career with people who genuinely want to see you succeed.

Our reputation has been built on delivering what we promise, supporting our clients and creating a culture where people enjoy coming to work.

When you join Singleton, you're not just filling a position - you're becoming part of a team that cares about doing great work and doing it the right way.

What you'll be doing

No two days are the same, but your responsibilities will include:

Supporting Project Managers with the day-to-day coordination of construction projects.
Preparing project documentation, schedules and reports.
Coordinating subcontractors, suppliers and internal teams.
Tracking project progress and helping identify potential risks before they become problems.
Maintaining accurate project records and documentation.
Communicating with clients to provide updates and ensure an outstanding customer experience.
Supporting project closeout and handover activities.
Helping keep multiple projects organised and running smoothly at the same time.

Requirements

What we're looking for

You'll be someone who enjoys bringing order to busy environments and takes pride in getting the details right.

You'll Likely Have

Previous project coordination, project administration or construction administration experience.
Excellent organisational and time management skills.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
Confidence working with multiple stakeholders.
The ability to prioritise competing deadlines.
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and project management systems.
Construction industry experience is beneficial, but not essential.

Most importantly, we're looking for people with a positive attitude, a willingness to learn and a genuine desire to build a long-term career.

What success looks like

In this role you'll become someone the team can rely on.

You'll anticipate problems before they happen, keep projects organised, communicate confidently with clients and colleagues, and help ensure every project is delivered to the high standards Singleton is known for.

Don't tick every box?

That's okay.

Research shows that many great candidates won't apply unless they meet every requirement. If this role excites you and you believe you'd be a great addition to our team, we'd encourage you to apply.

We're interested in potential just as much as experience.

Ready to build something great?

If you're looking for a role where you can grow your career, make an impact and work alongside great people, we'd love to hear from you.

Benefits

Why you'll love working here

Opportunity to work on nationally recognized construction programs.
Career development with clear progression opportunities.
Supportive, collaborative project teams.
Exposure to a wide variety of construction projects.
A company where your contribution genuinely matters.
Competitive salary and benefits package.

Apply for this job
